text:
leah_sales: Heads up — ClientX POC kickoff tomorrow 9am PT. They want a drop-in adapter for competitor Y's API with prompt parity and billing mapping. Main asks: prompt parity, response field compatibility, rate-limit mapping, and security questionnaire. @mike_se can you lead tech presales?

mike_se: On it. Can we get sample traffic? @oliver_customer can you share 3 example calls and expected outputs? Prefer Postman collection or curl snippets.

oliver_customer: I'll upload a small Postman collection and a csv of 200 sample prompts. Also: they require SSO and SOC2 attestation; data residency question pending.

sara_security: I can start the security questionnaire this afternoon. Quick Q: do they require HSM-backed KMS or is Cloud KMS ok? Also confirm whether logs need to be retained on-prem.

leah_sales: They asked for KMS/HSM option and VPC peering for Dedicated. Pricing question from procurement: competitor offers per-request plan vs our per-token — they're asking for committed capacity vs burst pricing. @tara_legal can you review contract terms for data deletion and subprocessor lists?

tara_legal: On it. Please send the customer's DPA and the questionnaire. I'll prepare redlines focusing on data deletion SLA and audit rights.

mike_se: Tech note: competitor's responses include legacy fields like `response_text` + `meta.hints`. Two approaches for parity: (1) implement a proxy shim that rewrites our responses to include legacy fields, (2) add a compatibility mode flag to our API that returns legacy schema. For POC, proxy is faster and safer.

david_eng: Implementation estimate: proxy shim + mapping rules ~3 engineer-days to get a working POC (smoke), plus ~5 days for edgecase handling (tokenization differences, nested metadata). Prompt parity requires an eval harness + 500 seed prompts to measure deltas.

oliver_customer: We'll provide the 500 seed prompts by EOD and mark the deterministic examples (they run temp=0.0 by default).

mike_se: Good — we'll match temp=0.0 and deterministic sampling where possible. Note: different model families will still diverge; we'll quantify delta via BLEU/ROUGE + hand checks and propose heuristic mappings.

leah_sales: Action items: mike + david — build shim POC and run initial eval; sara — start security questionnaire; tara — draft contract redlines; I will prepare committed-capacity pricing options (monthly/annual) and a short TCO comparison vs competitor. Sync tomorrow 9am PT. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Reminder: staging cluster reserved for ClientX POC 2024-06-12 → 2024-07-12. Allocated GPUs: 2xA10. Please coordinate teardown requests in the #eng-infra channel.

mike_se: I'll post a minimal curl example for the shim mapping here and a small test harness.

mike_se: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  -H "X-Compat-Mode: competitor-y" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-13b","prompt":"Summarize...","temperature":0.0}'
```

leah_sales: Thanks everyone — see you on the sync. If anything urgent pops up, @mike_se and I are on call.
